turns.customer: We're new! Can we use the First Stay & Play offer for 3 nights in a luxury suite for our pup Ziggy, Jan 26 to 29 2027?
blocks:
Happy Tails’ published **First Stay & Play** offer is for new clients: one night at the **Standard room rate**, with play the following day for **$0**. A Luxury Suite is an upgrade, so the upgrade cost is paid by the customer; the offer does **not** make all three nights or the Luxury Suite free. It includes a **free group-play evaluation only**, not individual play. Participation may vary by resort, is subject to availability, and the offer can’t be combined with other discounts.

For Ziggy’s requested **January 26–29, 2027** stay, the regular Luxury Suite estimate is **$270** (3 nights × $90 per day). Boarding is billed by the day, and staff confirm the final total. Peak or seasonal pricing may apply. The offer terms don’t specify how the Luxury upgrade is priced within an offer stay, so I can’t calculate an offer-adjusted total. Happy Tails staff can clarify the upgrade pricing and participation at **(512) 764-6150**. I can also help prepare a booking request, but I can’t check availability for those dates.
